text:
pagerbot: [PAGER] Unusual auth activity detected: high 401/403 rate tied to a service account token (sa-deploy-2024-prod) originating from 52.23.11.5 in us-east-1, flagged by auth-rate-detector.

alice: I'm on it. pulling logs and checking session table. @mike can you join? :eyes:

mike: oncall here, taking token audit. any immediate customer hits? @jenn fyi.

alice: Quick tail of auth log: 
```
2026-03-16T22:12:01Z GET /v1/generate 401 token=sa-deploy-2024-prod ip=52.23.11.5 user_agent="svc-proxy/1.2"
2026-03-16T22:12:05Z POST /v1/embeddings 401 token=sa-deploy-2024-prod ip=52.23.11.5
```
Suspect token reuse across multiple regions. Could be leaked.

sara: Legal standby. If potential data access we need to preserve logs and a timeline. No customer comms without Legal signoff.

jenn: Product/CS—are we seeing any errors surfaced to customers or billing anomalies? I can open a CS bridge.

robin: I've added a temporary WAF rule to block 52.23.11.0/24 and quarantined a few infra-proxy workers. Blocking reduced noise. Need approval to rotate prod key.

mike: Plan: immediate key rotation + controlled rollout. ETA ~15m. Steps I'll run: 
1) create new key sa-deploy-2024-prod-v2 in vault
2) update k8s secret infra/sa-deploy-token from vault
3) rollout infra-proxy deployment with canary (10%)
4) revoke old key in IAM after canary verification
5) monitor traffic and customer errors

alice: doing quick smoke vs canary endpoints now.

pagerbot: @alice acknowledged by pagerbot

mike: Rotation started. will post revoke timestamp. Revoke scheduled at 2026-03-16T22:30:00Z pending canary health.

jenn: CS: two customers reported elevated 401s ~22:10-22:35; flagged them to CS triage. Adding @customer-success for outreach.

sara: Legal: preserve all logs for timeline. Do not purge rotated keys or logs until we verify. Prepare short notice template; I'll review.

alice: Canary at 10% is healthy after 5m. increasing to 50%. No regressions in latency or 5xx.

robin: WAF block holding; 401s decreased ~60% from peak.

mike: Old key revoked at 2026-03-16T22:31:05Z (revocation confirmed). Monitoring auth-rate and 5xx/401 charts.

alice: 401/403 rates back to baseline across regions. No new suspicious IPs seen. Marking mitigation as successful for now. :white_check_mark:

jenn: Customer impact summary: 2 customers experienced ~20-25m of elevated 401s; no confirmed data exfiltration. CS will send an initial outreach once Legal approves wording.

sara: I'll sign off on the notice draft once Security confirms no data access. Also request retention of full request/response logs for forensics.

alice: On-call handoff: @oliver will take follow-up and lead the postmortem. I'll drop runbook notes and a log export into #incidents-postmortem.
oliver: ack, taking ownership for follow-up. I'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:00 PT and collect artifacts.

incident-comm-bot: Incident #2026-03-16-42 created. Severity: P2. Owners: oliver, mike. Postmortem due in 72h.

alice: closing pager for now; reopen if recurrence or additional intel. Thanks all.
